page.overview:
Who is Casey Marie Jones?

In the continuity of The Last Ronin, Casey Marie Jones is the daughter of her late parents and .

Casey Marie is tall, slender, but muscular Caucasian young woman with black hair and fair skin with green eyes. She was 17 years old during the initial first 5 issues of the Last Ronin.

Casey Marie is headstrong, stubborn, and wants to fight for what is right, she cares a lot about the people in her life. But also, she does seem to get more impatient at times and jump into things. Like how she jumped into a battle even when Michelangelo told her not to. Another example is later on in the series, in the Lost Years issues, when she tries to train Moja, Uno, Yi, and Odyn as babies and gets upset when it's not yet going how she planned.

Later on in the Lost Years issues, she is seen being more of a caring and adjusted sensei to her children. Giving them advice, helping them when they need it, telling them stories about her life. She and her mom, April raise the turtles.
